note: GTA VI random encounters and stranger missions. Separate from story missions (story-missions.json) and Online contact missions (online-missions.json). Economy relevance: strangers provide supplemental GTA$ income, item rewards, and occasionally unlock side businesses or contacts. Coordinates mark trigger locations on the world map — see data/gta-6/world/map.json.

fields.name: string | null — descriptor (many are unnamed in-game)
fields.regions: string[] — region IDs where encounter can trigger
fields.trigger_coordinates: {x: number|null, y: number|null} — approximate spawn/trigger point
fields.trigger_radius_m: number | null — radius in game metres where encounter can spawn
fields.reward_type: string — gta$ | item | reputation | contact-unlock | none
fields.repeat_cooldown_hrs: number | null — real-world hours between repeats
fields.weather_condition: string | null — any | rain | clear | etc.

day1_checklist: Record all random encounter trigger locations with game-cartesian coordinates
Note GTA$ rewards and repeat cooldowns
Flag any encounters that unlock contacts or side businesses
Record time-of-day and weather conditions for conditional encounters
Aggregate total GTA$/hr from strangers as supplemental income source
